summary: Engineering plan written: every spec decision mapped to a file, 12 risks each with a detection path, 13 pre-flight gates, ADR-0021 referenced. No blocking open question.

Lineup column shipped end to end. Every gate passes at 100 percent coverage. Two plan deviations: the migration is nullable because Aurora DSQL rejects every constraint on ADD COLUMN, and on a phone the column sits on the artist line because inline it collapsed the title to one character. One ratified metric remains unmet and needs a product call: a twenty character title truncates at 360 px, and did so before this branch added a column.

The implementation worktree branch merged into the designated branch with no conflict on any of its 54 paths. The blueprint index was stale after the merge and was regenerated. eslint over apps/pragma and tsc --noEmit in apps/pragma both pass on the merge commit.

Both validation blockers closed and nothing else touched. The dead maximumVisibleLineupMembers export, its two constants, its only caller in its own sibling test and MemberLineup's never-passed maximumVisible prop are gone. The InstrumentsList marker now names organism-presentational, which is what the component is: it calls no query hook and takes every value as a prop from InstrumentsPage. Eslint, prettier, tsc, knip, the core suite at 1824 tests and the per-file coverage gate all pass.
